Three of the 12 mention arbitration:

- **Acme_MSA.pdf**, §14.2
- **Brightline_SOW.docx**, §9
- **Northwind_NDA.pdf**, §11

The other 8 readable files have no mention. I couldn't check **Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf** because it's a scanned image with no extractable text, so it could contain an arbitration clause. It needs OCR or a manual read to rule it in or out.
